authorizingStandsMeaning: Soak recorded a monorepo tip that contains expiry≠dead + BOOTTIME + enriched supersede. The celldBuild label is explained by a harness bug (lab path hard-coded lab_fixed_alive_sweep_supersede and ignored FLEET_SOAK_CELLD_BUILD). V4 evidence from the same Mac mini run did not persist celldLabGitCommit or celldSha256, so binary-hash equality soak↔v4 is not in-artifact. Same-machine sequential CELLD_BIN procedure is the residual link; next boards must record identity fields.

r2IntentCheck.mechanism: Per mid-flight trial, board queries survivor /program/status for intents[] + pauseKind (durable view backed by R2). Missing readable empty view → lost_midflight_intent correctness failure.
r2IntentCheck.note: No separate supersede-audit JSON was pushed with this Mac mini tip; intent visibility is the board-embedded R2/durable check that gates lost_midflight_intent.

duringCallEffectDistribution.meaning: Validity: every during_call trial saw mock inFlight before kill (251/251). Effect split: mock writeCount was 0 on all 251 — kill landed while the call was in flight before pets committed a write. The phase did not also exercise a during_call trial with writeCount=1; after_intent_before_call was likewise 264× effects0. Outer phases still show effects1 on completed writes.
